_comment: Stored fixture for Playwright fresh-organisation runs. Each run provisions a brand-new organisation via the seed service's provisioning module, runs the whole suite against it, then deprovisions it in globalTeardown. This file is the human/CI record of what a provisioned organisation contains; the live result of the current run is written to .runtime/org-state.json.

organisationTemplate.whitelistedItems: all active global items (org-level codes carried from DEFAULT_ORG)
organisationTemplate.stock: SALE_STOCK + MAIN_STOCK + RETURN_STOCK, store 'default' sale_issue/sale_return mappings, opening balances per item
